name: Ring of Animal Influence
desc: This ring has 3 charges, and it regains 1d3 expended charges daily at dawn. While wearing the ring, you can use an action to expend 1 of its charges to cast one of the following spells:   Animal friendship (save DC 13)  Fear (save DC 13), targeting only beasts that have an Intelligence of 3 or lower  Speak with animals
